mapper.sql: uoms.id AS id, uoms.id AS id, uoms.name AS name, uoms.type AS type, uoms.abbr AS abbr, uoms.description AS description, uoms.modified AS modified, uoms.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM uoms LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = uoms.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = uoms.modified_by
WHERE uoms.is_active = 1 AND uoms.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR uoms.type LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO uoms ( type, sys_code, name, abbr, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{uoms.type}, UUID(), #{uoms.name}, #{uoms.abbr}, #{uoms.description}, NOW(), #{uoms.createdBy}, #{uoms.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE uoms SET `type` = #{uoms.type}, `name` = #{uoms.name}, `abbr` = #{uoms.abbr}, `description` = #{uoms.description}, modified = NOW(), `modified_by` = #{uoms.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{uoms.id}
